description: An envelope above §2.8's 64 KiB. **The only limit that can be enforced before allocation**, which is what §4 step 1 asks of it: the rest are enforced as the message is read and are bounded by this one. The oversize is in `signed`'s third segment, so the input keeps the shape of a JWS compact string; the signature does not verify and never needs to, because step 1 precedes step 3 and an implementation that reached verification has already allocated for 65 KiB of attacker-controlled input.
